note: Variable schema for the t538 design model and surrogate. To add a variable: append an entry to 'inputs' (name, lo, hi, default, unit, group, label) and, if the direct model does not already read it, register a hook in model_t538.HOOKS; the surrogate reads this file for its input columns and normalisation, so no surrogate code changes. 'sample': false keeps a variable fixed at default in the sampled design space (still a column).
labels: STATEMENT = read from a source/file; ESTIMATE = model computed; INFERENCE = reasoned; ASSUMED = input with no verified source

inputs.name: T_chip_K
inputs.label: chip (GPU) temperature limit, ~370 K planning requirement (author t544; Musk Jan 20 2026 '~370 Kelvin', GPU not junction, approximate). 370.0 used; no .15 precision claimed.

inputs.name: hbm_offset_K
inputs.label: HBM runs this many K below the chip limit (explicit HBM handling); 0 = HBM may sit at the 370.15 K chip temperature (stack is inside Micron 105 C = 378.15 K, above the 95 C qualification point 368.15 K, i.e. -2.0 K); effective limit = T_chip_K + hbm_offset_K [t547: superseded by explicit T_hbm_max_K / hbm_dT_K; keep 0]

inputs.name: q_plate_kW
inputs.label: heat through one cold plate (per GPU); repo COOLANT_CAP.md 1.2-1.7 kW (GB200-class); 150 kW / 72 GPUs = 2.08 kW is the all-in IT share (INFERENCE); default 1.7 = conservative end (ASSUMED)

inputs.name: R_plate_KW
inputs.label: junction-to-coolant resistance. 0.020-0.030 measured H100-class two-phase assemblies (doi 10.1115/ipack2024-141261); 0.0083-0.0085 skived Cu microchannel (doi 10.1109/itherm55375.2024.10709400); <=0.0065 (Illinois, experts.illinois.edu); 0.0105 replica microfluidic x0.35 (lab claim)

inputs.name: derate
inputs.label: sustained load fraction of nameplate peak IT power (clock derating / throttle at peak). Lowers heat and plate q; delivered kW/t = derate x P / M (compute per launch falls with it)

inputs.name: dT_loop_K
inputs.label: coolant temperature rise across the loop; plate sees supply + dT_loop/2 (ASSUMED convention, THERMAL_t536 section 3); flow, pump power and fluid mass scale with 1/dT

inputs.name: mc_offset_K
inputs.label: Monte-Carlo median minus deterministic draw (t444, J8; ESTIMATE), subtracted from the allowed supply

inputs.name: eps0
inputs.label: radiator emissivity (0.92 baseline; 0.95 = e95F100 coating option, INFERENCE)

inputs.name: coat_F0
inputs.label: coating-dependent effective factor on F_eff (0.99 baseline, 1.0 = e95F100 option; t454)

inputs.name: alpha_eol
inputs.label: solar absorptivity of the radiator (0.2 BOL baseline; 0.30/0.36 EOL in c52)

inputs.name: qscale
inputs.label: scale on Earth IR + albedo heat load seen by the radiator (1 = baseline LTAN 6 h, beta 58.99 deg draw u=0.25; <1 = attitude/orbit change, ASSUMED proxy; 0 would be no environment)

inputs.name: yoke_Feff_scale
inputs.label: multiplier on the view-factor-derived F_eff (yoke root / array-bus blockage; 1.0 = render yoke 4.137 m, t444)

inputs.name: fin
inputs.label: fin thermal table: 0 = F1_L60_t0p8 (the table behind the reported 377.38 / 378.55 K), 1 = F3_L40_t0p5 with K13D 30x0.20 mm (t479 eta_cell 0.9142 >= F3 0.9062, area factor 0.9913, INFERENCE) which is -4.4 K at the same area (c52)

inputs.name: hp_lift_K
inputs.label: heat-pump lift between chip loop and radiator loop (0 = none). COP = hp_eta x Tc/lift (Carnot fraction); work adds heat and array power

inputs.name: hp_eta
inputs.label: fraction of Carnot COP (0.5/0.3 used in c52; ASSUMED)

inputs.name: hp_kg_per_kW_el
inputs.label: heat-pump hardware mass per kW electric (NO public figure found: ASSUMED placeholder)

inputs.name: P_mmod
inputs.label: 5-year no-puncture probability the radiator bumper is sized to (0.90 adopted t454 by the owner; old baseline was 0.85 / 0.76); stuffed-Whipple not used; repo Whipple model, ORDEM not run

inputs.name: standoff_kg_per_mm_panel
inputs.label: mass of the bumper standoff hardware per mm of standoff per panel. The repo bumper model has NO standoff hardware (0 = repo convention, ASSUMED); the Whipple mass saturates beyond ~70 mm standoff so P_mmod costs no mass in the replica; this knob exposes that gap (anchored at the baseline 61.7 mm x 77 panels)

inputs.name: standoff_hw_kg_per_panel
inputs.label: bumper standoff HARDWARE mass per radiator panel (absolute, added to the bumper line). ASSUMED, from CHECKS_t456.md: 5 g x 6 spacers per 2.94 m strip = 30 g per strip, 8 strips per panel (4 tubes x 2 sides) = 0.24 kg/panel; reproduces t456's +18.5 kg (Jun, 77 panels) / +30.7 kg (Aug, 128 panels). No public source found for the spacer mass. 0 = live baseline convention (hardware absent). 0.5 = about 2x, covers a standoff-scaled design (0.24 x 124 mm / 65 mm = 0.46 at Aug's standoff). Only the t456 sensitivity exists; this is NOT in the live baseline mass.

inputs.name: pump_spares
inputs.label: spare column pump modules per sat (baseline 2; the author rejected 2->1 at t462 so default 2)

inputs.name: spare_gpus
inputs.label: spare GPUs per sat (t523: 1 per sat, 5.67 kg Jun / 8.11 kg Aug each; also sets availability)

inputs.name: frame_kg
inputs.label: frame mass per sat (t494 M55J frame 28.21 kg Jun vs 70.8 kg lumped); default read live from the point file

inputs.name: struct_scale
inputs.label: multiplier on the structure_mech line (f_struct proxy; ASSUMED range)

inputs.name: adapter_kg
inputs.label: per-sat launch adapter (t481: deleted, 62 kg previously)

inputs.name: pcdu_kWkg
inputs.label: PCDU specific power (t474 plan of record 5.57; old 3.0; 12 kW/kg raw base)

inputs.name: bus_V
inputs.label: bus voltage (t536 confirmed 300 V; harness ~ 1/V^2 at fixed loss)

inputs.name: wing_scale
inputs.label: array specific power relative to the live line (332.4 W/kg Jun at C1). 1.572 = 522.7 W/kg = the aggressive C2 corner of the original SpaceX region (t423g, INFERENCE needed to reach SpaceX-like numbers); <1 = heavier array

inputs.name: reserve_floor
inputs.label: minimum reserve as fraction of (core+bumper-propellant): 10 % = lower edge of the original C1-C2 region (C2 growth), ASSUMED; 20.5 % = repo margin policy; evaluate also at 0

inputs.name: rpitch_mm
inputs.label: stowed radiator panel stacking pitch (10 mm baseline packer; 5-7 mm is a deploy-config lever, volume check only)

inputs.name: extra_mass_kg
inputs.label: generic hook: any later variable's mass effect

inputs.name: extra_power_kW
inputs.label: generic hook: extra electrical load (array/PCDU sized, also heat)

inputs.name: T_hbm_max_K
inputs.label: HBM limit: 368.15 = 95 C HBM qualification (H100 product brief THBM, via THERMAL_t536 sec 2, secondary); 378.15 = Micron HBM3E 105 C operating (STATEMENT, THERMAL_t536)

inputs.name: hbm_dT_K
inputs.label: HBM-to-coolant-reference rise; -1 = same as chip q*R (THERMAL_t536 convention 'HBM numbers are the die numbers'; no HBM-specific R found, ASSUMED)

inputs.name: pmad_eff
inputs.label: PMAD+harness efficiency; 0.92 = repo array-sizing convention (orbit_loop.py A_arr = P/(319.7*0.92*eol)), ASSUMED

inputs.name: pmad_heat_to_rad
inputs.label: fraction of PMAD/harness loss rejected by the main radiator (1 = conservative, no separate bus radiator modeled; 0 = live convention), ASSUMED

inputs.name: q_other_kW
inputs.label: avionics/laser terminals/ADCS heat on the main loop; no power figure in the replica (OMISSION flag), 0 default

inputs.name: fin_area_rel
inputs.source: t548 Warp fin_t548 (ESTIMATE): required planform vs live K13D 30/0.20 at equal duty

inputs.name: fin_mass_rel
inputs.source: t548 Warp fin_t548 areal (fin+tube+fluid) incl. bond, vs live K13D (ESTIMATE)

inputs.name: cref_frac
inputs.source: t549: where in the per-plate coolant rise the chip R is referenced (0.5 = t547 mean; 1.0 = plate outlet, conservative for series/worst GPU)

inputs.name: hbm_off_K
inputs.source: t549: HBM above die-equivalent rise; 8 K = gap between H100 HBM 95 C and GPU TAVG 87 C qualification points (INFERENCE)
